sources.title: GitHub - kyutai-labs/pocket-tts: A TTS that fits in your CPU (and pocket)
sources.snippet: A TTS that fits in your CPU (and pocket). Contribute to kyutai-labs/pocket-tts development by creating an account on GitHub.

sources.title: Pocket TTS Loom Packages 100M Model for Edge Devices
sources.snippet: Pocket TTS Loom repackages Kyutai's 100M-parameter English Pocket TTS as a self-describing GGUF for loom.cpp, enabling local speech synthesis without cloud APIs or an external phonemizer.

sources.title: Pocket TTS: a high-quality TTS with voice cloning that runs on CPU
sources.snippet: These two changes make the modeling task much easier, allowing for a smaller model, but are deterministic and come with a limited set of voices. With Pocket TTS, we manage to bridge this gap and obtain a tiny model that runs on CPU without sacrificing any advantages of the larger models.

sources.title: Kyutai's Pocket TTS runs 100M-parameter speech on a CPU, no GPU ...
sources.snippet: Kyutai releases Pocket TTS, a 100M-parameter speech model that runs 6x real-time on a MacBook Air M4 CPU, with voice cloning and browser support.
